correctness.rationale: Irreducibility forces a group endomorphism to annihilate or biject the elementary-abelian kernel. Composition-idempotence then gives either identity or a conjugated complement power-map retraction indexed by CRT idempotents; direct substitution proves product/support laws, counts, image orders and centralizers. The included checker enumerated generator-image homomorphisms in eleven finite cases and passed all exact checks; finite checks do not prove the all-parameter theorem.

value.rationale: For a natural infinite group family the theorem calculates the entire group-retraction band, establishes unusual closure and the left regular identity, gives every retract image size, every centralizer within the band and the complete ordered commuting-pair census. The prime-divisor support interaction is structural and makes these results useful independent of any external theorem.
